remarks: This charming two-bedroom, one-bathroom apartment in the heart of Greenwich offers unbeatable convenience. Nestled close to the train station, Bruce Park, and Greenwich Avenue, you'll enjoy effortless access to the area's best shopping, dining, and entertainment. Inside, enjoy a spacious living room with a cozy fireplace, a dining room, and a well-equipped kitchen. The bonus den provides extra space for a home office or guest room. Relax on the private back patio, perfect for morning coffee or small gatherings. Plus, the convenience of in-unit laundry makes everyday living easier. This is the perfect place to enjoy all that Greenwich has to offer.
